Here's everything we have on the grocery app. What's the real pain? Rank them — we can only fund one.

1. Analytics (Amplitude, checked monthly, stable for 6 months): 42% of ALL checkout sessions abandon at the delivery-slot-selection step. That's ~21,000 abandoned checkouts a month out of ~50,000. No other step loses more than 6%.

2. From a user interview last month: one restaurant owner said reordering her weekly bulk staples takes too many taps. Separately, a sales rep forwarded an email where a prospect mentioned "reordering is tedious." So we've got two different sources both pointing at a bulk-reorder pain — feels triangulated?

3. The ops team wants us to build a substitutions dashboard (they've asked twice).

Note: we don't have support-ticket tagging set up yet, and nobody has interviewed anyone about the slot-selection step specifically — the funnel number is all we have there. But honestly the bulk-reorder one has more kinds of evidence behind it, so maybe that's our validated pain?
